producer_report.summary: Redid the goal-preservation change. The reader prompt now names the request's audience, requires one acceptance criterion that audience can check, forbids putting the request's own goal in out_of_scope, and says to read the output a request is about before planning a change to it. The producer prompt treats the criteria as a floor and serves the goal. The verifier prompt judges user-facing output as its audience would and rates a reading mismatch major. In the verifier prompt, "it" now reads "Athena". judge() adds a Major finding and a reason when request_reading_mismatch is non-empty, so the verdict is not pass. Two new unit tests cover a mismatch present and a mismatch absent or blank. The reader budget goes from 1,800 to 1,930; the reader set measures 1,927 against 1,798 before. D93 in docs/decisions.md records the count and why removals cannot pay for it. The CHANGELOG has an entry. Every 1,800 mention you listed is updated, and docs/records.md notes the new mismatch behaviour. Dated review-1 figures and the review documents stay as past-tense records.

learnings: The producer and verifier prompts are near their budgets: study producer was 1,099 of 1,100 and study verifier about 1,238 of 1,300. Any added prompt text there has to be paid for with trimmed wording.

A unit test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs pins exact verifier phrases ("a result about the snapshot only", "say so explicitly in evidence and findings", and others), so those sentences cannot be reworded.

The backtest reads decisions.md for the word "amends" followed by a decision id and treats it as an amendment hit. Writing "amends D25" in D93 failed the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list.
D93 was the next free decision id; the log ended at D92.
